Container.Name: aonarr-server
Container.Overview:
AoNarr is a self-hosted media manager that unifies Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr/Prowlarr/Bazarr/Whisparr-style functionality across 10 library types (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Music, Books, Comics, ROMs, Online Videos, Courses, Adult) in one app.
This is the API/backend container. You also need the "aonarr-web" container (same repo, "web" tag) for the browser UI — install both. The web container talks to this one over the Docker network by container name, so keep this container's name as "aonarr-server" unless you also change the AONARR_SERVER_HOST variable on the web container to match.
On first boot, open the web UI and create an admin account (username/password) — no API key needed. To skip that screen entirely, set the Admin Username/Password variables below before first start.
Point the Downloads and Media paths at the same shares your download client and media library actually use — AoNarr resolves completed downloads and organizes files under Media itself, it doesn't just track them.
Container.Requires: Install "aonarr-web" as well for the browser UI.

Config.Name: WebUI/API Port
Config.Description: Port the API listens on. The aonarr-web container proxies to this.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Root of your media library — the same share your root folders (configured inside the app) live under.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Shared downloads folder — must be the same path your download client (qBittorrent/SABnzbd) writes completed downloads to.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are created as — 99 is Unraid's default 'nobody' user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are created as — 100 is Unraid's default 'users' group.

Config.Name: Search Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often the scheduler auto-searches monitored, fileless items.

Config.Name: Queue Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often the scheduler polls download clients for progress.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Optional: auto-creates the admin account on first boot instead of using the web UI's setup screen. Leave blank to set it up in the browser instead.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required if Admin Username is set (min 8 characters). For a Docker secret file instead, use AONARR_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE.
